the_typed_gate.note: the provider's own words: it sees only the country the CONNECTION exits from — the runtime's egress region is refused, not the key, not the account; the machine cannot choose its egress (Art. XXXIII: no owner decision taken by the machine)

admission_decision: NOT ADMITTED — probe-before-admit (R451-C1.2 / Art. III) holds: a tiny completion through the real endpoint is the ONLY admission evidence, and zero completions are measurable from this egress (the catalog itself is gated, so not even one served model id is measurable — a guessed default rung would manufacture knowledge, Art. VI / XXVII). No ProviderSpec is registered; the Art. LXV escalation is opened instead (R462/TOKENHARBOR_OWNER_ESCALATION.json). The measured specimen still registers the provider-agnostic REGION_NOT_SERVED class in provider_health so ANY provider answering this 403 class classifies honestly (never AUTH_FAILURE).
